params.content:
Date: 2026-01-28

Actions taken:
- Pulled recent posts from Buffer for organization_id=org_001 using buffer_get_posts (arguments: organization_id=org_001, channel_id=null, status=sent, days=90).

Buffer API response (verbatim):
{"success": true, "posts": [], "total": 0}

Analysis:
- No posts were returned by Buffer, so engagement-based analysis by hour and day of week cannot be computed from our posting data.

Assumptions made (reasonable defaults since ss_social_analytics ws_config was not accessible via available tools):
- Engagement rate formula when data is present: engagement_rate = (engagements / impressions) * 100 (expressed as whole-number percentage).

Recommendations and next steps:
1) Verify Buffer integration and that org_001 has sent posts in the past 90 days. Consider expanding the lookback window or exporting historical posts if needed.
2) If you can provide an analytics export (CSV or enable API access), I will compute engagement rates by hour and day-of-week and produce best/worst time slots per your analytics criteria.

Fallback recommended weekly posting schedule (industry best-practice fallback until we can run data-driven analysis):
- Monday: 10:00 AM (mid-morning)
- Tuesday: 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM (mid-morning + early afternoon)
- Wednesday: 11:00 AM (late morning)
- Thursday: 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM (mid-morning + mid-afternoon)
- Friday: 9:00 AM (early morning)
- Saturday: avoid or 11:00 AM if posting
- Sunday: avoid

Logging note:
- This Notion page was created under parent page: ss_social_analytics (ws_timing) to serve as the analysis log since the dedicated ws_timing endpoint/tool was not available.

If you want, I can: expand the Buffer query window, fetch per-channel posts, or accept an uploaded CSV of historical post metrics and rerun the analysis to produce: (a) engagement-rate heatmap by hour and day-of-week, (b) best and worst time slots (ties broken by earlier time), and (c) a recommended weekly schedule with percentages.
